name: ITACA cylinder | illustrative homogenized SiC bed

provenance.cavity: User-supplied experimental description: diameter 104.92 mm, height 85 mm, solid-state generator 2350–2500 MHz.
provenance.supplement: Malhotra et al., Temperature Homogeneity under Selective and Localized Microwave Heating in Structured Flow Reactors, SI ie0c05580_si_001.pdf, pp. 1–5; supplied locally by user.
provenance.sample: Main paper p. 6838 confirms a 10 mm diameter × 15 mm solid-cylinder benchmark and a 10 mm ID tube around a 15 mm monolith. Here the envelope is filled with an illustrative packed bed. Quartz thickness 1 mm remains assumed.
provenance.material: Illustrative effective SiC bed table, NOT the paper's monolith or a transferred 2D fit. Replace with material and packing-specific measurements.
provenance.port: Radial ideal 50-ohm lumped probe; 8 mm length and mid-height position assumed. Actual coax dimensions, windows, and S11 calibration are unavailable. Main paper p. 6837 motivates impedance walls and first-order scattering boundaries at tube exits.
provenance.empty_cavity_loss: Main paper pp. 6837–6838 reports 7–11 W empty-tube accepted power and an 8 ± 1 W comparison offset; this is recorded as evidence, not subtracted automatically from loaded runs.
provenance.flow: Optional packed-bed Darcy flow. The SI's millimetre-channel monolith requires explicit channels or a measured homogenized permeability and is not reproduced by this bed profile.
